controls.normativeStatement: The tuple networkAuthority, networkIdentifier and networkVersion shall identify exactly one RDF NetworkReference record and one checksum.
controls.remediation: Merge duplicate edition records under one persistent IRI, or assign the correct authority, identifier, version and checksum to each distinct edition.

controls.normativeStatement: A superseded edition shall resolve through dct:isReplacedBy to one in-graph successor with the same authority and network identifier, a distinct version and an allowed replacement-target status; candidate, current and withdrawn editions shall not state a successor.
controls.remediation: For a superseded edition, publish exactly one in-graph successor with the same authority and network identifier, a distinct version and an allowed status. Remove dct:isReplacedBy from candidate, current and withdrawn editions.

controls.normativeStatement: Every superseded or withdrawn network edition shall state networkValidUntil so that its terminal validity interval is bounded.
controls.remediation: State networkValidUntil as an xsd:date not earlier than networkValidFrom for every superseded or withdrawn edition.

controls.normativeStatement: The inclusive validity interval of a superseded edition shall end before the inclusive valid-from date of its successor.
controls.remediation: Set networkValidUntil to a date earlier than the successor networkValidFrom and retain both dates with their xsd:date values.
